name: Migration Rollback
description: If migration fails or produces incorrect results, roll back to SQLite as the authority. Rollback must be tested.
purpose: Migration is reversible until final cutover.
acceptanceCriteria: Rollback procedure is documented step by step
Rollback restores SQLite as the authority without data loss
Rollback preserves existing PGlite data for debugging
Rollback procedure has been tested end-to-end
Rollback completes in bounded time (under 5 minutes)
